item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello hello LaSpruca! Welcome to the Wiki! I'm Ralliston, a site author and a member of the Community Outreach Team - with this helpful little comment, I'll try to help you find your way around the site and link a bunch of useful places and links that will help you in your SCP journey.

It's awesome to see that you also think the SCP Wiki is a place of great creativity and interest - hopefully, during your stay here, you're not going to get disappointed with all of the stories you'll get to read here. It's also really nice to see you want to contribute to that, too. I can't wait to see what you'll come up with!

Without further ado though, let's click the collapsible, shall we? :)

+ show block
– hide block

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our Sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts, which are in-works articles. Using it, you can link the drafts to reviewers to get their opinions on them before posting. It really helps everyone out a lot.

For brainstorming concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by experienced members of the community if you need help refining and fleshing out your concept. It's a very helpful little place for when you want to start your writing journey, especially when you're not sure if the idea is all that great.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles. Within the Guides, you will find useful information written by experienced members of the site for the use of newer ones.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success! Remember - there is no rush to writing - take your time! The more time you spend on fleshing your ideas out, the more your chance of success becomes!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community to implement into your very own writing. Alternatively, you might want to look at the User Curated Lists page, where members of the community list and rank their favorite articles in different genres and themes, showing which attempts at such are successful and what the community likes.

Best of luck with your future contributions to the site! I hope you enjoy your time here as much as we do! If you have any more questions, feel free to message me here on Wikidot or on the IRC chats!

item.content:encoded:
Hi everyone!

I recently got into the SCP lore and have always wanted to write something, so I figured: why not try writing an SCP? I'll need to lurk a bit more before I can get to writing, I don't wanna rush this and make a poor quality SCP.

Other than that, I am a huge anime and video game fan, and I play the drums since I was 5.

Basically any thought can keep me up at night, given my OCD, but sleep pills help a lot (lol).

I'm looking forward to share my ideas and interests with all other site members! :D

item.content:encoded:
Hiya!! I'm cabinetcat !!
It/they pronouns
I've been into scp for years and recently my old hyperfixation has come back so I decided to finally join the site. I'm a fan of horror especially things like scp, I love reading about them and maybe I'll write one of my own sometime but idk!

Other things I really like are idol games, Nintendo, writing, reading, drawing, music, gardening, mythology, space, theater, and a lot other things.
I also really like cats

I'm kept up at night mostly worrying about the ones I care about or just my wild thoughts keeping me awake, I tend to get random ideas for art or writing and I can't sleep. Also insomnia. And trauma. Yeah.

Anyways, that's all I can think of writing, I don't like talking about myself.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hello!

My name is Meadowsky, and i'm very grateful to get accepted into this site.

I'm a big fan of the SCP Foundation since 2018, thanks to my close friends. Though i have stumbled upon the SCP universe in as early as 2016, but i expressed little interest at that time. I am fascinated by the stories, tales and writing of SCPs by those famous youtubers. For now i don't know what to do besides exploring, commenting and talking with other site members. I do have a plan on making an SCP, but i need to master my writing skills and character development first.

I am an introvert, i play games, mostly in mobile, listening to American and German contemporary music, reading sci-fi books and doing household chores.

What kind of random thoughts keep you up at night? I constantly think of completely random scenarios, making thoughts and ideas on making a new SCP, and my uncertain future.

I guess it's time to use my hidden potential for this community,
I'm excited to be part of the SCP wiki!

Hey sir Critical, welcome aboard. Believe it or not a lot of people join this site from some video they have seen or another which is great for us! Its always great to have people eager to contribute but also take time to familiarize with how things work on the site. There's never a rush as this stuff definitely isn't going anywhere.

For my recommendation, you should check out SCP-4900

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Good Morning All! My Name is James, I have been an avid reader of the SCP wiki for about 8 years now but have really regained my love again in the last year. I have practised many times with writing short stores and weird stuff but this will be my first time trying anything public so I hope to get lots of criticisms with writing, as well as any tips&tricks you can all help with. I am hoping to dip my toe into all aspects of the wiki including feedback, but I do wish to see how all the forums work and get a feel for the community to start off with. As for the Question of the month, I've always been obsessed with space, as I'm sure most of you do as well, I often get lost in how small we are. But frankly, I find it very humbling.
